scope: Concrete Supervisor/HTTP composition through existing Task/Result/Error/try APIs; no new public operation or language rule
implementation_after: S1 latest four-OS required CI and main merge
source_forms: saved Low reloaded without original High

native_cases.name: business-and-normal-shutdown
native_cases.trigger: actor reply business Err, healthy counter reply, explicit actor shutdown
native_cases.expected: 409 then200; after normal actor shutdown HTTP503 remains live; separate HTTP signal closes server; scopeOk

native_cases.name: terminal-body-error
native_cases.trigger: restart intensity exhausted while HTTP stays healthy; typed monitor receipt Ok(innerErr); parent try inner
native_cases.expected: original monitor Error kind/message; direct HTTP Future destroyed and listener stopped before parent returns; external shutdown signal unused

native_cases.name: weak-discarded-monitor-counterexample
native_cases.trigger: same terminal innerErr; typed monitor explicitly discarded
native_cases.expected: monitor-returned barrier establishes produced business Error; HTTP remains responsive503; external finite HTTP signal then scopeOk; this is valid Nagi behavior illustrating incorrect service composition

native_cases.name: legacy-http-error
native_cases.trigger: real HTTP returns controlled Error while monitor remains active
native_cases.expected: first observed legacy HTTP Error kind/message remains primary; monitor abort requested; direct child drain completes; separately retained Control elects actor drainer and confirms successful cleanup

native_cases.name: monitor-task-panic
native_cases.trigger: normal actor shutdown and actual run cleanup, then monitor adapter panics
native_cases.expected: outer TaskFailure Panicked; diagnostic handling cannot clear sticky scopeError; HTTP cancelled/joined; do not promise arbitrary panic payload text

native_cases.name: parent-drop
native_cases.trigger: actor readiness and live HTTP request established, then parent future dropped while waiting for monitor
native_cases.expected: synchronous Drop only requests abort; independently await HTTP Future destruction/listener stop and successful actor::shutdown with retained Control; no synchronous/transitive join guarantee

examples.supervised-service: typed monitor + legacy HTTP; business reply, normal shutdown and current API behavior preserved
examples.task-results: spawn/one-time receipt/canonical move/nested business Err/unit discard; Counter output oracle and final-after-scope suffix

limits: HTTP Future cancellation aborts nested connections; direct server join is not arbitrary handler close completion
No SupervisorContext Arc is held by sample WebState (Actor/Control only); external retained context awaiting monitor can create a cycle
Error alone from actor::shutdown does not prove cleanup; no-worker-failure cancellation cases must require successful Ok
Monitor body Error wins only after parent receives it and executes try; HTTP fault observed earlier legitimately wins
Non-yielding work, native blocking/Drop, external rollback, general Future storage and task detach remain outside supported guarantees
